motions.name: broken_2
motions.line: Dammit...have we lost...? Take everything you can. Don't let them profit at our expense!

motions.name: broken_3
motions.line: I only got hurt because I was busy warning the others...

motions.name: broken_4
motions.line: Fire at will! Don't stinge on ammo now!

motions.name: broken_5
motions.line: Hurry up or we'll not make it to the limited-time sale at the mall!

motions.name: touch_1
motions.line: Did anyone drop their combat reports at the training ground? …If nobody's claiming them, then I'm taking them.

motions.name: touch_2
motions.line: I'm leading the team this time so there's no need to worry, Commander!

motions.name: touch_3
motions.line: I get so anxious looking at the T-Dolls that do their work so carelessly… I might as well take over the work myself!

motions.name: touch_5
motions.line: Ah, that new seat cover? I embroidered it myself. Beautiful, isn't it? Let me know if you want me to make you anything, Commander!

motions.name: touch_halloween
motions.line: What's the deal about this festival anyway? There are no discounts... Huh? There's free candy? C-count me in!

motions.name: wedding
motions.line: Commander, are you really sure about choosing me? You're taking advantage of me, aren't you...<>I am in fact a good homemaker…and I'm not bragging. You got a good deal out of choosing me, Commander.<>I-In any case, I'll be with you from now on, so don't regret it!

motions.name: wedding_touch
motions.line: Commander, Commander? You'll catch a cold if you sleep at your desk. Ah…it's a mess here. Go to your room. I'll clean up here for you.
